prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage Farah working alone at a bridge analysis console, her body in a three-quarter side stance leaning slightly into the task, eyes following a loop on the screen. Camera is diagonally beside the screen, not directly facing her. Her right stylus traces the return path; her left hand rests on a small open notebook lying flat on the bench. Remove the held tablet and floating stage-like hologram. Use a compact angled working display with two method rows: Rollout: Past feeds Model feeds Prediction, and Prediction returns into Model by a clear loop labeled Next input. Second row One-step replay: Observed history feeds Model feeds Prediction; a separate New observation arrow joins Observed history. No arrow returning from the lower Prediction. Her focused half-smile is about catching the input difference. Every text baseline, box and connector lies in the perspective of the display. No numerical forecast, arbitrary chart, or confidence cone. Spare monitors and table emitter off. Keep balanced stylized proportions and exact canonical face, natural short neck, two connected arms, believable grip. Soft warm skin, muted sage and worn brass against charcoal, no neon. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.

iterations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit with immutable canonical identity. Cinematic Deep Orbit adventure-comic scene,1536x1024. First reference images are canonical faces, next is bridge master for room/palette, LAST is exact scene to edit. Preserve exact people, facial morphology, adult age markers, warm skin, nose/jaw/eye proportions, hair, side-specific accessories, expressions, story action and entire room composition. Keep every continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chain, grips, torso/head alignment, thighs, chair support and rail contacts intact. Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear, Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye. Make only requested screens and small proportional adjustments. Keep narrative people dominant; embed concise task meaning in existing screens rather than turning scene into a full technical infographic. All peripheral monitors, wrist displays and unmentioned readable displays must be OFF, plain charcoal glass with no arbitrary bars, waveforms, gauges or text. Retain physical buttons. Muted sage, aged brass and charcoal with natural warm skin; no neon mint, cyan or mustard wash. Preserve Farah stylus grip and tablet grip, stance, face and smile. Her head is visibly large: reduce complete head modestly to about92 percent of current linear size, preserve exact face structure and natural short neck. On existing hologram replace rising arbitrary points with TWO simple method rows. Top heading "Rollout" with "Past" into "Model" into "Prediction". A visible return loop from Prediction back to Model is labeled "Next input". Bottom heading "One-step replay" with "Observed history" into "Model" into "Prediction"; a separate input arrow labeled "New observation" joins Observed history. No return arrow from this lower Prediction. All arrowheads and paths must be clear and connected. Keep this diagram compact with short labels. The tablet back remains unchanged; do not put a screen on its back. Turn all background monitors off. No numerical outcomes, fake sampled waves or invented forecasts. cel-shaded cartoon illustration, clean bold linework, flat shading with one soft key light, slightly stylized proportions, cinematic character and environment framing, near-black space beyond the viewports, green #6BAA8A interface glow and rim light, warm brass #A89060 metal trim, cohesive series look, not photorealistic. Output one full scene only.
